you_need_to: If you wrote your own concern pack, widen its ANYTIME_PLUGIN engine range to include 0.4 (for example ">=0.3,<0.5") first: the 0.4 engine refuses a pack whose range stops at 0.4.
Re-sync: ./anytime-engine/sync-to.sh <your-repo> (add the packs you use), then python3 -m anytime_engine.selftest.
